findings.text: follow-on: the max_concurrent_runs field description still says dispatch counts non-terminal pointers and refuses a dispatch past the ceiling, which the landed change makes false; the file is outside the node's declared write paths.
follow-on: the key's published description mirrors the same now-false enforcement claim, so the flight schema documents a cap dispatch no longer applies.
follow-on: roster_bound's backend and occupancy parameters are no longer read by the retired entry, leaving two dead arguments its callers still supply.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 531027092; 208cc43d3 turns the roster bound into a retired entry, drops the roster refusal branch, rewrites the bound comments, updates three test files and adds one, and 11a32aa4f adds only the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_backend_carries_no_worker_cap.py with a stub backend declaring max_concurrent_runs: 2, three non-terminal pointers and a fourth dispatch admitted, a retired summary entry, and a spent 2-core reservation still refused; the file drives all three and the manifest records base and head each 14 failed at -n 8 with zero added ids.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to retire the max_concurrent_runs roster cap from dispatch while the partition-cores and login-memory bounds stay enforced; reckon/crew/summary.py:284-302 reports the roster entry retired and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:640-653 refuses only on summary.binding_bound, so the cap no longer refuses.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states head 14 failed/1579 passed/2 skipped EXIT=1 at 208cc43d3, the base arm the same 14 ids EXIT=1, a logged negative control EXIT=1, commits 208cc43d3 and 11a32aa4f, base revision 531027092, and names gate_head.log, gate_base.log, gate_head_candidates.log and negative-control.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; every path in the diff (reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/summary.py, tests/test_backend_carries_no_worker_cap.py, tests/test_crew_binding_bound.py, tests/test_concurrency_bound_refuses_by_name.py, tests/test_lane_concurrency_ceiling.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-dispatch-returns-without-its-worker/a-backend-carries-no-worker-cap.html) is inside them.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log reddens all three new cases with EXIT=1 when the roster enforcement is restored in summary.py, so tests/test_backend_carries_no_worker_cap.py fails if the change regresses, though two pre-existing ceiling tests became vacuous.
justifications.evidence: gate_head.log and gate_base.log each end "14 failed, 1579 passed, 2 skipped" with byte-identical failing-id sets (base_fail.txt and head_fail.txt), so the run adds no failing id, and negative-control.log ends EXIT=1 with the fourth dispatch refused under restored enforcement.
justifications.fit: the retired entry follows the Bound idiom and the docstrings state the mechanism, but reckon/crew/summary.py:278 leaves roster_bound's backend and occupancy parameters unread.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/summary.py:284-302 returns the roster entry as value "retired" with utilisation None and admits_one_more True, and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:640-653 refuses only on summary.binding_bound, so max_concurrent_runs no longer refuses any dispatch.
justifications.scope_discipline: the seven changed paths are all inside the manifest's declared write paths, and no bound other than the roster is altered.
